ui_bugs.issue: The single try/catch wraps BOTH the backend POST /api/graphic-plan/share AND navigator.clipboard.writeText(url). When clipboard permission is denied (any non-secure/sandboxed context, iframes, headless testing, some mobile browsers) writeText throws and the catch surfaces toast.error('Error al compartir la gráfica') to the user — even though the share record has already been created server-side. User perceives share as broken. Same defensive pattern needed in handleChartShareWhatsApp (line 1443) for symmetry (though wa.me open works there).

integration_issues.issue: Backend share endpoint apparently succeeded (call happens before clipboard) but user never gets the URL because clipboard failure short-circuits the success toast. Cannot verify shared viewer page {origin}/api/graphic-plan/shared/{id} quality until share flow returns the URL to the UI.

issues: Multiple `DialogContent requires a DialogTitle` a11y console errors + Missing Description warnings — pre-existing, not blocking, but should be wrapped with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle.

Ensure a long plan (>52 weeks — e.g. annual→biannual/olympic via Duración selector, or seed a 104-week plan) exists in test account so BUG#3 horizontal-scroll + week-slider drag on the >52w path can be verified. Currently only the 26-week 'Plan Test API' is available.
Optional: add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to expand & other DialogContent to clear the recurring a11y console errors.

rca of the issue: Share bug RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/GraphicPlan.js handleChartShareLink (lines 1422-1441) contains one try{...}catch{} block that includes both the POST to /api/graphic-plan/share AND `await navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl)`. In Playwright (and many real browser contexts where clipboard is blocked by permission policy / non-user-gesture) writeText throws NotAllowedError, jumping to catch → toast.error('Error al compartir la gráfica'). The backend record was already created (fetch resolved with r.ok=true, d.share_id available in scope before the writeText call). Fix: wrap only the clipboard call in its own try/catch OR fall back to prompt()/hidden textarea+execCommand('copy'). Reproduction: login as coach, open Plan Gráfico, click Share2 icon in 'Duración y Actividad' header → toast error appears though shared row exists in DB. Mitigation: also render the returned URL in a small dialog so users always see something copyable.
